scope: Bounded static review of proposed owner source facade and two-dependency source/frame graph after V9 timeout. No maintained edits, tests or owner execution.
verdict: The proposed owned standalone source facade addresses the earlier forged-reader counterexample if implemented with the stated full source preflight/consume/final and fresh checks. No concrete additional blocker found in the abstract design, but it is not yet code or qualification; reentrancy and cross-node metadata/final coverage require the explicit controls below. The facade is not the original CJS source guard and the function identity and callback sampling intentionally change.

predicate_mapping.old: Actual CJS inspector constructor executes source fact judgments and full original physical-only sourceGuard once.
predicate_mapping.new: Construct unmodified authenticated CJS inspector without supplied reader and retain private original result and captured 715-source fact result; immediately copy and validate its returned bound before any later user callback. Its constructor inserts every repairs.bound item through CJS member(ref), supporting finite union coverage.

predicate_mapping.old: CJS source assertCurrent checks root, metadataOk for entry/body/review/proof, equality to constructor snapshot; repairs.assertCurrent; then own source bound physical hash/size and supplied bytes; metadata again.
predicate_mapping.new: Source node preflight and final use strict physical source-bound checks and constructor-equivalent root, metadataOk and deep snapshot including review/proof fallback. Consume each validated source member exactly once with physical-before + expected hash/size, supplied Buffer equality and physical-after equality. This is a substitute owned predicate, not execution of the private original guard.

predicate_mapping.old: Outer owner preflight and final check inspector identity, source.assertCurrent descriptor identity, frames.assertCurrent and guardNode pointers, source+frame union physical refs, request metadata.
predicate_mapping.new: Outer own preflight/final check exposed facade source-guard pointer, actual inspector and genuine private source guard identity, frame guard/node identities and relevant metadata. Both genuine nodes run their physical preflight and final checks; ensure exact overlap consistency and preserve each node-specific reader path, symlink/root constraints and sourceMember physical policy. No path-union last-write-wins.

facade_requirements: Facade must retain all exposed factual fields and independent bound/historical-context copies with the prior shapes. Its owned assertCurrent must invoke complete standalone source node so a forged supplied source buffer still rejects. Keep metadata/captured source judgments inaccessible to caller mutation and retain outer pointer-accessor poisoning rejection; do not represent the facade function as original CJS guard or alter the independently exported CJS inspector.

Capture authentic source.bound before any subsequent user callback, validate exact own data structure, path uniqueness and digest/size, include every repair bound member by source trace, compare overlap to actual frame refs. Private CJS result and internal snapshots must not be exported through the facade.

Genuine metadataOk is an exported function whose body calls lexical helper and handlerRef; authenticate captured function/image/identity under the trusted committed startup model. Match actual CJS root resolution, review and proof fallback and constructor-equivalent snapshot, plus outer owner checks. Do not infer arbitrary hostile-loader attestation from function text.

Owner graph must depend on the actual frame and actual source node; preflight all nodes before callbacks and final-check all after. Distinct owner instances remain distinct. No externally supplied source node, reader registration or cached owner result.
reentrancy_and_cross_node: Shared same-source-instance consuming flag must guard the source predicate itself, direct facade entry and outer owner entry even if node runs inside a different scheduler; cleanup in finally, and preserve explicitly accepted caught nested rejection semantics. Per-scheduler running state alone misses alternate-scheduler calls.

Frame→source and source→frame are distinct node scopes; do not simply assume their locks block each other or blanket-reject supported nesting. Test both directions with actual callbacks, including nested late changes to the other node’s members, and verify the enclosing outer operation final sweeps reject persistent drift after the last callback. If policy intentionally forbids cross-node nesting, document its observable behavioral change.

A frame callback can poison the exposed source facade or loaded inspector after source preflight but before source consume. Execution must use captured trusted callable/node and outer post-callback descriptor/identity checks must reject persistent drift without invoking getters or redirected functions. Likewise a source callback can poison frame pointer or alter earlier frame member; full graph finals must catch it.
limits: The finite CJS source node does not cover untracked product population or absent paths; those remain separate authentic owner predicates and cannot be elided when composing a larger operation.

No supplied callback is made during CJS physical-only construction; delaying original constructor sampling is an explicit contract choice. Frame construction can call user read before the source snapshot, so the prepared source graph is not whole-constructor cold preflight.

Full owner and source facade may observe a changed count/order of callbacks, allowed only under the stated contract. Direct source guard must still reject every actually consumed forged Buffer; do not infer a pass from prior constructor or prior operation.
Cold/final endpoint checks do not establish continuous immutability. No performance, acceptance, G11 or canonical application claim follows.
minimum_real_controls: Standalone source facade positive then nonphysical source Buffer, old/new same-path mutation and clean retry; ensure source facts/bound shape preserved.

Real outer graph cold source corruption restored by first frame callback, late source callback mutating earlier frame file and late frame callback poisoning facade/inspector; reject without invoking accessor and retry.
Same-source reentry under direct facade, outer owner and alternate composed scheduler; frame→source and source→frame nesting, caught and uncaught cases with final checks and recovery.
Captured root/review/proof/metadata mutation including getter, bound omission/duplicate/conflict, untracked population and absent path through their actual separate owners.
After actual implementation and attribution refresh run the unchanged complete original source CLI cold/late regressions and actual owner under original deadlines; focused tests do not substitute.
